decision_rule: Admit PPO only if the s60 repair repeats behavior retention and strict outcome-surface diversity on fresh seeds while M62 remains clean.

no-action neutrality or perturbed-only source coverage is ignored
hypothesis: M132 s60 anchor20 repairs M129's proof-surface shrinkage while keeping behavior. A formal repeat gate should determine whether it is robust enough for PPO continuation.
